bull_case: Specialty, oncology and GLP-1 volumes plus software for drug access keep operating profit growing double digits, while heavy buybacks and the Med-Surg separation sharpen the mix toward higher-growth businesses.
bear_case: Pharma profit growth well above the 5-8% long-term target may revert as GLP-1 volumes normalize, and drug-pricing reform, 340B changes or a major customer loss could squeeze a business that earns about 1.4% operating margins.
key_risk: US drug-pricing policy and large-customer bargaining power compressing distribution economics.
catalyst_note: Option Care stake closing in 1H 2027 and the Wellverse (Med-Surg) IPO targeted for 2H 2027.

bull_case: With global supply constrained and few new plants coming, a low-cost US producer can generate heavy free cash flow and keep retiring stock, while Blue Point positions CF for low-carbon ammonia demand.
bear_case: Current prices reflect a war-driven supply shock; a normalization of Gulf exports, more Chinese urea exports or higher US gas prices would compress margins while Blue Point capex rises.
key_risk: Nitrogen prices falling back as Middle East and Black Sea supply disruptions ease.
catalyst_note: Yazoo City complex restart in the first half of 2027 and spring 2027 application season.

bull_case: Pricing, cost savings and lower tariff costs are lifting Plumbing margins toward 20% even with flat volumes, so any recovery in repair and remodel demand should flow through strongly to EPS amplified by steady buybacks.
bear_case: Volumes have been flat to down for years, DIY paint keeps softening and dependence on Home Depot limits pricing leverage; rising debt to fund buybacks leaves less room if housing stays weak.
key_risk: Prolonged weakness in repair and remodel and DIY paint demand combined with Home Depot customer concentration.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 guidance in early 2027; any pickup in existing-home sales.

bull_case: Healthcare workforce shortages and hospital partnerships support steady enrollment and margin growth; the FY27-29 plan targets 6-11% revenue and 9-16% adjusted EPS growth with buybacks shrinking the share count.
bear_case: New federal loan caps could keep slowing Chamberlain and Med/Vet enrollment, leaving growth reliant on Walden online; rising credit-loss provisions, the CFO change and reliance on adjusted earnings could compress the valuation.
key_risk: Federal aid changes (Grad PLUS removed, professional loans capped) cutting medical-school enrollment and pricing.
catalyst_note: Fiscal Q2 2027 results around early February 2027 and the new CFO appointment.

bull_case: Long-term contracts and AI demand make this cycle longer and higher than past ones, so peak-looking earnings persist.
bear_case: Memory remains cyclical; industry capex responds to 87% margins and pricing collapses in 2028-29.
key_risk: Supply response (Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron's own expansion) ending the shortage.
catalyst_note: December quarter results; 2028 contract negotiations.

bull_case: The largest audience and dealer network let CarGurus keep raising revenue per dealer while expanding into AI-driven dealer software, and debt-free cash generation funds steady share count reduction.
bear_case: Revenue growth is decelerating as dealers face margin pressure, international dealers churn and AI search threatens to commoditize listing traffic, leaving earnings growth dependent on buybacks.
key_risk: AI assistants disintermediating car-shopping traffic and dealer leads.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 outlook in early 2027, with ongoing buybacks under the new $250M program.

bull_case: Cabometyx keeps growing with exclusivity secured to at least 2030 and funds heavy buybacks; approval of zanzalintinib in March 2027 and a kidney-cancer win would make Exelixis a multi-product oncology company before the cliff.
bear_case: Essentially a single-product company facing a 2030 cliff; the FDA already delayed the zanzalintinib decision once, and a rejection or weak STELLAR-304 data would leave no clear replacement.
key_risk: Dependence on cabozantinib ahead of US generic entry around 2030, with the replacement pipeline hinging on zanzalintinib.
catalyst_note: Zanzalintinib PDUFA 3 Mar 2027 (metastatic CRC); STELLAR-304 topline Q1 2027.

bull_case: Two global brands with premium pricing, strong international growth and a net-cash balance sheet that funds large buybacks; refreshed HOKA franchises could restart growth in 2027.
bear_case: HOKA may be past its trend peak as Nike, On and others crowd cushioned running, while UGG relies on wholesale and a hesitant consumer; underlying margins are flattered by temporary tariff refunds.
key_risk: HOKA losing share as competition in cushioned running intensifies.
catalyst_note: Q3 FY27 (holiday) results in late January 2027 and spring 2027 HOKA product launches.

bull_case: Recurring domain renewals fund heavy buybacks while Airo, whose bookings run rate doubled to over $100M in a quarter, drives higher-margin product attach and ARPU growth.
bear_case: AI interfaces and cheaper rivals erode hosting and website-builder demand, domain growth plateaus and promotions to defend share cap pricing, leaving growth reliant on buybacks.
key_risk: AI-driven changes in how small businesses get online eroding GoDaddy's core hosting and builder products.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 guidance in February 2027.

bull_case: Store growth continues at about 8-9% a year with new units performing well, buybacks shrink the share count, and a successful January price reset could stabilize traffic from a much lower valuation base.
bear_case: The post-pandemic surge in comps is unwinding and price investment needed to win back shoppers from mass merchants and discounters could compress the margins that drove past earnings growth.
key_risk: Negative traffic persisting even after price cuts, forcing deeper margin sacrifice.
catalyst_note: January 2027 pricing reset and Q4 2026 results with 2027 guidance in late February 2027.

bull_case: At gold well above its roughly $1,500/oz all-in sustaining cost, Newmont generates large free cash flow, holds net cash and keeps shrinking its share count while new projects come online.
bear_case: Gold has already rolled over from record levels; if it keeps falling while Q4 unit costs rise toward $1,900/oz, margins and buybacks would compress quickly.
key_risk: A sustained fall in the gold price from cyclical highs.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 guidance (around February 2027) plus Red Chris investment decision early 2027.

bull_case: A cash-rich, still-growing franchise priced at ~12x earnings as if AI will erode it; if AI features lift ARPU instead, the multiple re-rates.
bear_case: AI lowers the skill barrier Adobe's moat rests on; growth decays toward single digits and the low multiple is deserved.
key_risk: Seat and pricing erosion as AI-native design tools take share of new creators.
catalyst_note: December fiscal-2027 guidance under the new CEO; AI-first ARR trajectory.

bull_case: A mandatory, recurring service with sticky clients and roughly $750M of annual free cash flow funds a growing dividend and buybacks; if AI tools keep lifting conversion and retention, the selloff on AI fears looks overdone.
bear_case: Flat filing volumes leave growth reliant on price increases, while AI assistants and free filing options could gradually erode the paid assisted market; rising compensation and legal costs are already pressuring margins.
key_risk: AI-driven or government free filing eroding willingness to pay for assisted tax preparation.
catalyst_note: Investor Day with multi-year targets on December 3, 2026, then 2027 tax season results.

bull_case: A capital-light services model with 25%+ operating margins, steady online and hybrid nursing growth, and a shrinking share count; the regulatory cloud over GCU has largely cleared.
bear_case: Near-total dependence on one university, an amended contract that narrowed billable revenue, declining ground enrollment and buybacks funded beyond free cash flow leave little room for a regulatory or enrollment shock.
key_risk: Concentration on GCU and its access to Title IV federal aid.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 guidance in February 2027.

bull_case: Standalone after the Family Dollar sale, Dollar Tree is beating guidance, multi-price items have grown to 17% of sales, traffic is positive and strong free cash flow funds buybacks; FY26 EPS guidance of $7.70-8.05 may have room to rise.
bear_case: Part of the 2026 earnings jump rests on a one-time tariff refund now contested in court, management expects Q4 gross margin pressure, and Walmart and Dollar General fight hard for the same shopper.
key_risk: China tariff and sourcing exposure with limited pricing room squeezing margins once the refund benefit fades.
catalyst_note: Q3 FY2026 earnings and outlook update on 24 Nov 2026.

bull_case: Clients struggling to get value from AI tools are turning to Gartner for business cases, contract value growth has accelerated for three quarters, and buybacks are rapidly shrinking the share count while adjusted EPS grows.
bear_case: AI erodes the value of paid research seat by seat, keeping contract value growth in low single digits and turning a former compounder into a slow-growth, buyback-driven story.
key_risk: Generative AI substituting for paid research subscriptions and capping contract value growth.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 outlook in early February 2027.

bull_case: A $95B AI backlog plus a strong refresh in traditional servers and storage gives multi-quarter revenue visibility, and gross profit dollars keep rising even as margin rate dilutes.
bear_case: AI server margins are thin and component constrained, PC margins are guided down to about 6%, and a slowdown in AI capex or a stumble at a large neocloud customer would hit a levered balance sheet.
key_risk: An AI infrastructure spending downturn or memory supply squeeze hitting a thin-margin, debt-funded business.
catalyst_note: Q3 FY27 earnings on November 24, 2026 and any update to the FY27 AI server revenue target of about $74B.

bull_case: B2B is becoming the travel industry's supply backbone, which AI agents need, so Expedia benefits rather than loses.
bear_case: AI assistants book direct with hotels or via Google, and the consumer business shrinks while marketing costs rise.
key_risk: Disintermediation of consumer bookings by AI platforms.
catalyst_note: Q4 results and 2027 outlook (February); AI-channel booking data.

bull_case: AMS adds about $650M of run-rate fee revenue and a $1.5B+ contract backlog in recruitment outsourcing, making revenue more recurring, and management expects the deal to be EPS-accretive in its first full year.
bear_case: A hiring slowdown or AI-enabled recruiting could squeeze search and RPO volumes just as the firm takes on debt and integration work for its largest acquisition.
key_risk: A cyclical hiring downturn hitting search and RPO fees while leverage is elevated after the AMS deal.
catalyst_note: Fiscal Q2 2027 results in early December 2026 with the first AMS contribution.

bull_case: Store pruning and focus on the three core banners are lifting margins (FY27 adjusted EPS guidance raised to $10.45-12.15), and a strong balance sheet funds continued buybacks.
bear_case: Falling unit volumes are masked by higher gold and price points; mall exposure, lab-grown deflation and a weaker consumer could cap sales while more restructuring charges recur.
key_risk: Sustained unit declines in a discretionary, mall-heavy category as diamond prices deflate.
catalyst_note: Q3 FY27 results in early December 2026 and holiday-season sales against guided flat to +2.5% same-store sales.

bull_case: Record Q3 with revenue up 27% to $423.6M, GMV and active buyers and sellers each growing over 20%, a debt-free balance sheet and ongoing buybacks. Europe and retail-partner sourcing add further growth avenues.
bear_case: Recent margin gains lean on a freight-rate spread management says it cannot forecast, while product margins compress and operating cash flow fell as inventory built. Tariff and China-structure risks could cap the valuation.
key_risk: Margin reversal if ocean freight spreads normalize while tariffs and third-party competition erode product margins.
catalyst_note: No dated event beyond Q4 2026 results in early 2027; Europe and retail-partner traction have unclear timing.

bull_case: Lenders, investors and securitization markets are built around FICO scores, so share loss may be slow, while the direct licensing program, Score 10T adoption and a fast-growing software platform keep earnings growing.
bear_case: Regulators are deliberately engineering price competition in mortgage scores, which have driven most recent growth; with leverage up, buybacks paused and guidance withdrawn, pricing power may not come back.
key_risk: FHFA-driven shift toward VantageScore forcing mortgage score price cuts.
catalyst_note: FHA dual-score acceptance from January 1, 2027 and possible reinstatement of FY27 guidance once mortgage pricing agreements close.

bull_case: Peak-cycle cash is being converted into buybacks at speed; if margins stay elevated into 2027, per-share value compounds.
bear_case: Earnings are near a cyclical peak; when cracks normalise, EPS could fall by more than half and the stock re-rates down.
key_risk: Refining margins normalising faster than expected.
catalyst_note: Q4 crack spreads and 2027 margin commentary; close of the refinery sale at end-2026.

bull_case: US and West Coast closures plus geopolitical supply shocks keep cracks high for longer, and Valero's low-cost fleet converts that into very large free cash flow and buybacks from a net-cash balance sheet, with a cheap Houston restart adding capacity.
bear_case: Q3 earnings of roughly $24 a share reflect a margin spike that should fade as supply disruptions ease, overstating earnings power at the top of the cycle; demand erosion, outages and regulatory costs remain.
key_risk: Refining margins falling back to normal from a geopolitically driven peak.
catalyst_note: Houston refinery acquisition closes by end-2026, restart targeted by end-2027; Q4 2026 results in early 2027.

bull_case: A low-leverage Williston operator that keeps beating volume guidance and cutting well costs, generating about $1.6B of 2026 adjusted free cash flow at elevated prices to fund buybacks and a solid base dividend.
bear_case: Earnings are past the Q2 2026 price peak, volumes are guided lower and capex and operating costs are creeping up; with crude back in the $60s free cash flow falls sharply and no other basin offsets it.
key_risk: Crude prices falling from 2026's elevated levels in a single-basin producer.
catalyst_note: Marcellus divestiture closing expected Q4 2026; 2027 guidance with Q4 results in early 2027.

bull_case: An ageing fleet, longer trade routes and congestion keep the market tight into 2027, letting Star Bulk pay out most of its earnings with a strong balance sheet.
bear_case: Deliveries of around 50M dwt in 2027 outpace roughly 2% trade growth, and normalizing port congestion releases capacity, pushing rates and dividends sharply lower from peak levels.
key_risk: Fleet supply growth outpacing cargo demand from 2027, ending the current rate upcycle.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and dividend in early 2027; Capesize rate direction over the seasonally weak first quarter.

bull_case: Shrinking US capacity and European import dependence could keep crack spreads above historical averages into 2027-28, sustaining large free cash flow for buybacks while the Lubricants spin-off surfaces value.
bear_case: Q3 2026 results ($11.38 diluted EPS) reflect a geopolitical margin spike plus EPA waiver benefits; both could reverse quickly, leaving a higher-cost refiner with much lower normal earnings.
key_risk: Crack spreads normalizing or EPA tightening small-refinery waivers, cutting refining earnings sharply from peak.
catalyst_note: CEO handover to Steve Ledbetter on 1 Jan 2027; Lubricants & Specialties spin-off expected during 2027.

bull_case: Net cash, steady free cash flow (about $815M year to date) and buybacks support the stock while the Gap brand's revival and a recovering Old Navy lift sales and margins.
bear_case: Old Navy, close to 60% of sales, keeps missing on assortment, Athleta continues to shrink, and once tariff refunds fade underlying margins look flat in a no-growth apparel market.
key_risk: Old Navy losing its value position as tariffs and weaker lower-income shoppers squeeze margins.
catalyst_note: Q4 fiscal 2026 results and 2027 outlook in early March 2027.

bull_case: High oil prices and Permian outperformance lifted the 2026 free cash flow outlook to about $2.9B, funding quick deleveraging and heavy buybacks. Suriname's GranMorgu offers a funded, carried growth leg from 2028.
bear_case: Q3 earnings reflect roughly $92 oil; a reversion would squeeze free cash flow just as 2027 capital rises about $400M with flat production. Egypt dry holes, production-sharing dilution and legacy decommissioning liabilities add downside.
key_risk: Oil prices falling from cyclically elevated levels while capex rises for Suriname and exploration.
catalyst_note: Net debt target by year-end 2026; Alaska exploration and appraisal wells in 2027; GranMorgu first oil mid-2028.

bull_case: Demand for high-quality human data keeps growing as labs move into reasoning, agents and robotics, and Innodata now has two large anchor customers, a hyperscaler ramp worth over $20M in 2027 and a net-cash balance sheet.
bear_case: A small vendor in a crowded, project-based market with extreme customer concentration; program cancellations, insourcing or automated data generation could stall growth while margins are already compressing.
key_risk: Loss or scaling back of one of its two largest AI customers.
catalyst_note: Q4 2026 results and 2027 guidance around late February 2027; federal contract signing expected by year-end.

bull_case: Aerie and OFFLINE keep compounding at double-digit rates, the stock trades below 10x earnings, and stabilizing the AE brand would lift group margins.
bear_case: Underlying profit is weak once one-time tariff refunds ($161M net in Q2) are stripped out, AE brand fashion misses force more markdowns, and inventory overhang pressures margins into holiday.
key_risk: Continued AE brand weakness and inventory markdowns eroding margins as tariff-refund benefits fade.
catalyst_note: Q3 FY26 results around early December 2026 against operating income guidance of $110-115M, then holiday results.

bull_case: Very high margins and around $1B of free cash flow let buybacks keep growing EPS on flat revenue (diluted shares down from 265M to 225M), with cost cuts and Dash/Tigris offering a possible AI growth leg.
bear_case: Bundled storage and AI assistants are commoditizing the core product while revenue and ARR stall; adding leverage to a no-growth business amid management turnover and an unproven AI bet raises the risk of equity impairment.
key_risk: Paying users and ARR eroding under bundled competitors while leverage stays high.
catalyst_note: Tigris acquisition closes Q4 2026; Q4 results and FY2027 guidance around Feb 2027.

bull_case: A tight global product market, EPA small refinery exemptions and a net cash balance sheet let Par bank windfall cash and redeploy it into buybacks and high-return projects across its niche markets.
bear_case: Q3 earnings were inflated by war-driven cracks and a one-time SRE benefit; a ceasefire or restored Gulf exports could push margins back toward 2025 levels while long-term fuel demand in Hawaii declines.
key_risk: Refining margins normalizing from war-driven highs, removing most of current earnings power.
catalyst_note: Laramie Energy sale close and RIN monetization by year-end 2026; Q4 results in early 2027.

bull_case: The turnaround is working: comps turned positive, Bloomingdale's is gaining share as Saks retreats, the balance sheet has no material maturities until 2030, and FY26 adjusted EPS guidance of $2.15-2.35 plus buybacks looks cheap.
bear_case: The core Macy's nameplate grows about 1% in a channel in long-term decline; Q2 was flattered by one-time tariff refunds, and a weaker value-conscious consumer or renewed tariffs could undo margin gains.
key_risk: Structural share loss at the core Macy's nameplate amid consumer and tariff swings.
catalyst_note: Q3 FY2026 results in early December 2026 and holiday/FY2027 guidance around March 2027.
